1.explanation: This demo mounts the Carbon Link component with the `inline` prop inside paragraphs on white, gray and dark backgrounds. Importing the Carbon CSS ensures the component’s modifiers (e.g. `--link--inline`) are applied. You can hover, focus, click, and disable the links to see if the underline and color states match the spec. If the underline or colors don’t update correctly, you’ve reproduced the bug with the inline variant.
1.bug_scenario: The new “inline” variant of the Carbon Link component is intended to render with an underline by default (for accessibility) and to properly display color-state styles (enabled, hover, active, focus, disabled, visited) across light, gray and dark backgrounds. In the current implementation the inline variant either isn’t underlined or doesn’t pick up the correct CSS states when you pass `inline` into `<Link>`, so you can’t verify the spec’s look in a paragraph.
